info.title: CIA Partner Open API
info.description: REST API for Insurtech partners to access insurance products and services

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Insurance products available to Insurtech partners

get.description: Returns all webhook registrations for the authenticated partner app

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Subscribe to one or more event types. All deliveries are HMAC-SHA256 signed via the X-CIA-Signature header. The secret is never returned after this call.

400.description: Validation error — invalid URL, secret too short, or unknown event type

post.description: Generates a premium quote for one or more risks. Returns immediately with calculated premium. The quote must be approved internally before a policy can be bound.

400.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields

post.summary: Bind a policy from an approved quote
post.description: Converts an APPROVED quote into an active policy and triggers an async NAICOM upload. The naicomUid field will read PENDING until the upload is confirmed.

400.description: Validation error or quote not in APPROVED state

post.description: Registers a new claim against the specified policy. The claim moves to REGISTERED status immediately; processing is handled internally.

400.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields

post.description: Creates a customer record and triggers asynchronous KYC verification. Poll GET /customers/{id} to check kycStatus until it is VERIFIED or FAILED.

400.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields

post.description: Creates a corporate customer and triggers asynchronous KYC verification against the CAC RC Number. At least two director IDs are required for KYC.

400.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields

201.description: Corporate customer registered — KYC verification initiated

get.description: Returns the quote with premium breakdown and current approval status
Returns all active insurance products for the authenticated tenant

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.description: Returns full details for a single product including rate and minimum premium

get.summary: List classes of business under a product
get.description: Returns the class(es) of business associated with the product — used to populate quote requests
Streams the approved policy certificate as a PDF binary. Returns 404 if the document has not yet been generated (policy not yet approved).

404.description: Policy not found or document not yet generated

get.summary: Get customer details and KYC status
get.description: Returns customer profile and current KYC status. Use to poll after registration.
Returns the current state of a claim including reserve, approved amount, and settlement timestamp

delete.description: Soft-deletes the registration; pending deliveries in-flight may still complete

targetUrl.description: URL that receives webhook POST requests

eventTypes.description: Event types this webhook is subscribed to

items.description: Event types this webhook is subscribed to

active.description: Whether this webhook is actively receiving deliveries

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the webhook was registered

PartnerWebhookResponse.description: Registered webhook endpoint details. The signing secret is never returned after creation.

totalSumInsured.description: Total sum insured across all risks (NGN)

totalGrossPremium.description: Sum of gross premiums across all risks before adjustments (NGN)

totalNetPremium.description: Final net premium payable after all per-item and quote-level loadings/discounts (NGN)

approvedAt.description: Timestamp when the quote approval was confirmed

rejectionReason.description: Reason for rejection if status is REJECTED

PartnerQuoteResponse.description: Insurance quote returned to Insurtech partners

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy

quoteId.description: Source quote ID if bound from a quote

brokerId.description: Broker ID if placed through a broker

totalSumInsured.description: Total sum insured across all risks (NGN)

rejectionReason.description: Reason for rejection if status is REJECTED

cancellationReason.description: Reason for cancellation if status is CANCELLED

naicomUid.description: NAICOM unique identifier; PENDING until the upload is confirmed

PartnerPolicyResponse.description: Policy record returned to Insurtech partners

policyId.description: Policy the claim is raised against

productId.description: Product ID associated with the claim

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the claim record was created

PartnerClaimResponse.description: Claim details returned to Insurtech partners

kycFailureReason.description: Reason KYC verification failed, if applicable

kycVerifiedAt.description: Timestamp when KYC was successfully verified

PartnerCustomerResponse.description: Customer record returned to Insurtech partners
